messages:
elaine: Heads up — noticing ~8-12% p99 decode latency bump on host-proxy after the kernel-selector rollout. Repro on canary. Suspect host-side parse/tokenize + streaming chunking.
mohit: I can reproduce locally. Flamegraphs point to a syscall spike in the chunking path during stream frame assembly.
ryan: Can you paste the perf snippet?
elaine: sure, high-level from the canary run:

```
  30.2%  host-proxy  [.] parse_frame
  18.7%  host-proxy  [.] tokenize_inline
  12.5%  host-proxy  [.] syscall:read
   9.1%  host-proxy  [.] memmove
   6.0%  host-proxy  [.] kernel_selector::choose
```

mohit: kernel_selector logs show it picked a fallback kernel for short sequences: "selected kernel: matmul_v2_fallback (seq=12)" — that version does an extra memcopy for alignment.
sam: kvcache hit rate looks stable on metrics (80-82%). This feels more host-level (parse/framing) than model cache churn.
elaine: yep — digging in, the streaming framer is emitting many small frames for certain clients (http2 gRPC smallwrite pattern), which triggers more parse cycles and forces the kernel selector to prefer the fallback path because seq distribution looks noisy.
perf-bot: ALERT: host-proxy p99 latency +0.09s since deploy 2026-03-21T22:40Z. Correlation with kernel-selector flag toggle.
mohit: micro-bench results: when batching heuristic is aggressive (flush-on-min-latency) we see batch sizes ~1-2 and 10% slower overall. Heuristic currently biases latency over kernel-friendly batching.
ryan: proposed quick fixes:
- prefer matmul_v1 for seq < 32 in the selector
- increase smallwrite batching timeout from 3ms -> 6ms for ingress path
- enable writev coalesce on http2/grpc ingress to reduce syscall count
elaine: I'll prepare a canary hotfix: tweak kernel priority + bump flush timeout + enable coalesce for ingress smallwrites.
sam: small experiment: coalescing writev on ingress reduced syscalls by ~40% and dropped CPU sys by ~12% in a short run.
elaine: patch diff (abridged):

```
--- a/proxy/config.go
+++ b/proxy/config.go
@@
- FlushTimeoutMicros: 3000
+ FlushTimeoutMicros: 6000
@@
- KernelPriority: ['matmul_v2_fallback','matmul_v1']
+ KernelPriority: ['matmul_v1','matmul_v2_fallback']
@@
- IngressCoalesce: false
+ IngressCoalesce: true
```

elaine: Deployed to canary 2026-03-22T09:12Z. Initial telemetry: p99 host-proxy down ~6%, sys CPU down ~18% on the canary hosts. Still watching for side effects (latency tail for very bursty clients).
ryan: nice. next actions: add selector unit tests for seq buckets, add perf harness case for http2 smallwrites, and run kvcache stress to ensure no regression.
mohit: I'll open the PR and include a benchmark. tagging @sam for the writev coalesce review.
elaine: thanks all — dashboard will show canary->prod cut if stable in 24h. :thumbsup:
